prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Full Bleed Layout: Redesign adoption certificate screen to a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing pet certificate details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Companion Overview Screen: Introduce a dedicated overview screen right before path selection to explain different companion journey types.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_overview": {"headline": "Explore Pet Path Types", "body": "Understand companion styles and journey options before making your selection.", "layout": "card"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Preview Flow: Add interactive companion audio and visual preview components directly on the pet selection screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:friend_preview", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:friend_audio", "style": "rounded", "action": "play"}]}}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Two Column Split Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured two-column visual split with clear method choices.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "two_column", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "choice_cards", "asset": "asset:sign_in_methods", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}
4: [finish, layout] Home Intro Compact Layout: Switch final home intro step to a compact layout for quicker onboarding completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact"}}
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Ready System Notification Opt-In: Add an explicit system notification toggle on the waiting screen when custom pet processing completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Hint: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in retains pet save data across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to keep your pet saved safely and prevent pet resets when opening the app again."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Upload Photo Lighting Guidance Hint: Display photo upload guidance specifying good lighting and high contrast photo requirements.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit photos with good contrast for accurate pet rendering."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Docking Progress Indicator: Enable progress bar and step counter on the waiting screen during desktop companion preparation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign story introduction screen into a stage layout focusing on initial pet narrative context.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "stage"}}
